name: Periprosthetic Fracture
definition: Fracture occurring around a joint prosthesis or fixation implant, requiring assessment of fracture pattern, implant stability and bone stock.

investigations.principle: Radiographs of entire implant/bone are first-line; CT may define fracture and implant stability.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Fixation versus revision arthroplasty depends on implant stability, fracture location and bone stock.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna care is secondary to modern implant-stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture occurring around a joint prosthesis or fixation implant, requiring assessment of fracture pattern, implant stability and bone stock.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
